faq_page.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_page.subtitle: Find quick answers to the most common questions about GetSomeHelp.

q1.question: How do I order a service?
q1.answer: You can order a service by selecting the service type, choosing a service provider, and confirming your booking through the app.

q2.question: How do payments work?
q2.answer: All payments are processed securely through Midtrans. GetSomeHelp does not store your card or payment details.

q3.question: What payment methods are supported?
q3.answer: We support credit and debit cards, bank transfers (Virtual Account), QRIS, and popular e-wallets such as GoPay, OVO, DANA, and ShopeePay.

q4.question: Can I cancel a service?
q4.answer: Yes, service cancellations are subject to the service provider’s cancellation policy. Please review the policy before confirming your booking.

q5.question: How do I contact customer support?
q5.answer: If you need further assistance, you can contact our customer support team through the app or via the support contact provided on the Help page.
